rationale.campaign_length: 31个B54直接任务叠加B20冒险者序章，完整路线延伸至中后期。
rationale.colonization: 前期有东坎诺冒险者迁徙与定居，但形成后主要依靠陆上征服。
rationale.complexity: 冒险者开局、独立资源界面、魔法研究、核心建设与终局战争同时要求规划。
rationale.dark_story: 尸体工业、灵魂征税、肃清、巫妖统治与大陆恐怖战争构成全程主题。
rationale.difficulty: 平时滚雪球很强，黑塔之战却会用内裂和外战集中检验准备。
rationale.diplomacy: 路线会主动制造外交孤立，终局更以反埃斯蒂尔联盟为主要压力。
rationale.early_pressure: 铁杖骑士团虽有强大法师，但仍要在混乱的东坎诺快速定居和扩张。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 专属死灵项目、法师国家、巫妖与莫古拉克斯均属于核心而非附加玩法。
rationale.narrative_density: 从禁书研究到亡灵经济，再到黑塔之战和黑暗帝国，叙事转折连续而集中。
rationale.tall_play: 亡灵经济强化农田、矿区、工业和卡斯托诺斯核心区，需要集中建设。
rationale.trade_economy: 亡者劳工、粮食、黄金、矿业和工业互相供给，是战争机器的经济底座。
rationale.warfare: 冒险者竞争、东坎诺征服和黑塔之战让军事能力贯穿全局。

identity.appearance: 1444年从铁杖骑士团B20开始；完成东坎诺冒险者定居并形成B54后切换专属任务树

predecessors.relationship: 唯一专属叙事前身；形成B54后换Tag并切换任务

successors.relationship: 可选后继形成国；形成后替换任务树，作为独立战役条目处理

gaps.reason: No unambiguous tag/culture national idea definition found; no predecessor inference.

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 随着绿潮的爆发，东坎诺的大片土地都沦为废墟。如果不是那些勇敢的魔法师们无视魔法师议会禁令的无私行动，绿潮肯定会征服整个坎诺。埃斯蒂尔正是由这些所谓的非法魔法师建立，我们敞开怀抱，接纳所有愿意加入我们的魔法使用者。
description.text_en: With the outbreak of the Greentide, vast swathes of land across Escann have been ruined. Were it not for the selfless acts of the brave magisters, in defiance of the Magisterium, the Greentide would have surely overcome all of Cannor. Esthíl itself has been established by these outlawed magisters, and it is with open arms that we accept any and all magic users who wish to join our realm.

description.text: 在坎诺各地，魔法被视为一种力量，需要在紧闭的门后，于秘密中发挥作用。但对于埃斯蒂尔，情况并非如此。世界将会迎来奥术黎明，所有法师都可以自由地使用魔法，而不用担心受到惩罚。
description.text_en: Throughout the lands of Cannor, magic is seen as a force that acts behind closed doors, in secret. That is not so for Esthíl. This is an Arcane Dawn for the world, when all may practice magic freely without fear of repercussion.

description.text: 埃斯蒂尔魔法学院是东坎诺最重要的魔法教育机构。虽然还有其他一些势力妄图与我们竞争这个头衔，比如努尔塞斯提尔，但所有人都知道只有最优秀的候选人才会被埃斯蒂尔接受并顺利毕业。
description.text_en: The Esthíli Academy of Magic is the foremost magical education institution in all of Escann. While there are those elsewhere who pretend to compete with our title, such as the Núrcestirans, all know that only the most elite of candidates are accepted and graduate from Esthíl.

description.text: 魔法师议会愚蠢地禁止了死灵系法术，这明明是最强大的魔法学派之一。我们应该批准它的使用，就像对待其他魔法学派一样，因为一个忠诚的死灵法师可以给我们的国家带来很多好处。除了免费的劳动力，死灵法师也会因此忠于我们的事业。
description.text_en: The Magisterium foolishly all but banned necromancy, one of the most powerful schools of magic. It is only fitting that we should sanction its usage as the other schools of magic are treated, for a loyal necromancer can bring many boons to our nation. Besides free manual labor, the necromancer themselves would remain loyal to the one cause that permits them.

description.text: 在一个被遗忘已久的地下室里发现的一份可怕的手稿，《黑暗秘密魔典》名副其实。它赋予那些能够阅读和理解它的人巨大的力量，但如果不能理解，就会有立即死亡的危险。
description.text_en: A horrid manuscript found in a long-forgotten vault, the Grimoire of Tenebral Secrets lives up to its name. It bestows great power to those who can read and understand it, but at the risk of immediate death if not worthy.

description.text: 远在阴暗和不祥的埃斯蒂尔城堡之下的秘所是一个巨大的迷宫，充满了无数的魔法神器和咒语书。来自四面八方的魔法神器被征收以满足精英魔法师们不断扩大的需求。
description.text_en: Far below the shadowy and ominous Castle Esthíl, the Mystic Vaults are a vast labyrinth filled with countless magical artifacts and spellbooks. From far and wide magical artifacts are tithed to fill the ever-expanding needs of the elite magisters.

description.text: 以前的由近战，齐射或偶尔的魔法爆炸所组成的战争现在改变了。随着一项新技术的出现，我们所有的士兵都可以拥有施展小法术的能力。所有人都会害怕埃斯蒂尔！
description.text_en: Previously the domain of melee, volley or the occasional magical blast, warfare has now changed. With the advent of a new technique, all of our soldiers can be equipped with the ability to cast minor spells. All shall fear the might of Esthíl!

name.text_en: Elementary Magical Education for the Soldiery

description.text: 在黑暗教义的宇宙学中，所有有能力使用魔法的生物都被定位在一个巨大的飞升链的某个地方，有时被称为「飞升之路」。在这条道路的接近尽头是所谓的「潜能者」，他们有潜在的魔法能力，但缺乏以任何一致和有意义的方式使用它的纪律。在遥远的尽头是宇宙意识，这是一种伟大的、冷静的、非个人的智慧，它弥漫在整个世界。飞升者是穿越这条伟大道路的人，成长在每一个阶段，直到他们与那最纯粹的智慧达到一个真正的结合。官方的说法是，每一位术士王都是飞升者，尽管任何与异教徒的严肃讨论都会揭示这是一个争论的焦点。
description.text_en: In the cosmology of the Black Doctrine, all beings with the capability to use magic are positioned somewhere in a great chain of ascension, sometimes called the 'Ascendant Path'. At the near end of this path are the so-called 'potentiates', people who have latent magical ability but lack the discipline to use it in any consistent and meaningful way. At the far end lies the Universal Mind, the great dispassionate, impersonal intellect which suffuses all the world. The Ascendant is the being who traverses this great path, growing in each stage until they achieve a true union with that purest Intellect. Officially, every Sorcerer-King was Ascendant, though any serious discussion with heretics will reveal that this is a point of much contention.

description.text: 飞升周是世界上最平等的制度之一，也是最分层的制度之一。无论社会阶层如何，所有非法师臣民在七天的美德庆典中都要参加相同的节日，参加相同的活动。然而，每一个使用魔法的人都被隔离在这些庆祝活动之外，而是和术士王一起在焚塔里度过一个星期的庆祝、放荡和激烈的政治活动。
description.text_en: The Week of Ascension was simultaneously one of the world's most egalitarian institutions and one of its most stratified. Regardless of social class, all non-magical subjects participated in the same festivals and shared in the same activities during the seven-day celebration of virtue. However, every magic user was kept separate from these festivities, instead joining the Sorcerer-King in the Charred Tower for a week of celebration, debauchery, and furious politicking.

description.text: 在凡俗国度的历史上，有各种各样的尝试来管理和控制魔法研究。事实上，对于一个健康国家而言，能对法师的活动施加至少一些基本限制便是颠扑不破的真理。但在黑暗领域，提出这样的规定不仅被视为愚蠢，而且是对教义本身的亵渎邪说。任何限制灵智发展的法律都是与教义相抵触的，而对魔法的禁绝则是其中最为令人发指的暴行。
description.text_en: There have been various attempts to regulate and control magical research throughout the history of the mortal realms. Indeed, perhaps one of the truest signs of a healthy state has been its ability to impose at least some basic restrictions on the activities of mages. In the Black Demesne, to suggest such regulations was not merely seen as foolish, but rather a blasphemous heresy against Doctrine itself. Any law which restricted the development of Intellect was opposed to Doctrine, and restrictions on magic were the most heinous of these.

description.text: 虽然非法师阶级无法爬到黑暗领域权力金字塔的顶峰，且权力相当非有限，但他们仍然可以尝试得到一定程度上的地位晋升。正是因为最有权势的职位仅限于魔法使用者，这些同样有权势的人经常选择与那些不可能构成威胁的人为伍。他们经常纯粹根据能力来提拔非魔法阶层的成员，以知识美德为基础来证明自己的高地位。这与其他许多王国形成了鲜明的对比，在那些王国里，晋升完全是凭血统的权利。
description.text_en: Though the non-magical classes could not ascend to the highest rungs of state power in the Demesne, and though they had very limited rights, they nonetheless rose in prominence. Precisely because the most powerful positions were restricted to magic users, these same powerful people often chose to surround themselves with those who could not possibly be a threat. They often promoted members of the non-magical class based on pure competence, justifying the high placement on the basis of intellectual virtue. This was in stark contrast to many other kingdoms, where promotion was by right of blood alone.

name.text_en: In the Eyes of the Great

description.text: 亡灵在战场上作为野蛮的士兵是有用的，但他们的独立思考能力或听从口头命令的能力非常有限。因此，黑暗领域非常需要活着的侦察兵、战场工程师和军官。对于非法师臣民来说，这种职位是通过提升自己对法师的价值而爬上社会阶梯的绝佳途径。每次宣战时，大量的最聪明的，有动力的，有野心的人涌入，以各种角色为军队服务，这种模式后来赢得了「死神之礼」的绰号。
description.text_en: Undead are useful on the field of battle as brute soldiers, but they have very limited capacity to think for themselves or listen to verbal orders. Thus, the Demesne had great need for living scouts, battlefield engineers, and officers. Such positions were an excellent way for non-magical subjects to climb the social ladder by making themselves valuable to mages. Every time war was declared, a great influx of some of the Demesne's most intelligent, driven, and ambitious people came to serve the army in all manner of roles, a pattern that would later earn the moniker of 'the Reaper's Gift'.

description.text: 在大多数社会中，法师都是典型的隐居学者，他们对战场上的荣耀不感兴趣，只有一小部分人倾向于拿起武器，将他们的天赋用于荣耀战场。在黑暗领域，对于每个法师学徒来说，至少在军队服役一段时间是一种期望和个人义务。如此庞大的魔法人力资源使得黑暗领域能够将整个高级军官军团变成法师的专属职位，从而实现分散的、响应迅速的魔法战术，这比任何一个术士单独完成的任务都要令人印象深刻得多。
description.text_en: In most societies, mages are typically reclusive academics who have little interest in battlefield glory, and only a smaller portion have the inclination to take up arms and lend their talents to the field of glory. In the Demesne, it was an expectation and personal obligation for every magical initiate to serve for at least some time in the military. This vastly greater pool of magical manpower allowed the Demesne to turn the entire upper officer corps into the exclusive province of mages, allowing decentralized and responsive magical tactics that were far more impressive than any single sorcerer could achieve alone.

description.text: 在最大的范围内，黑暗领域有八个侍祭，每个侍祭都戴着一个乌木戒指，按照魔法威力和在宫廷中的显赫程度从第一到第八编号。术士王戴着一枚与之相配的暗金色戒指，象征着统治地位，后来被称为第九枚戒指。从理论上讲，只要一个人戴着一个侍祭的戒指，他就有义务在所有事情上对第九枚戒指的合法持有者绝对忠诚。这种等级制度和控制的提醒强化了黑暗领域上层阶级的政治秩序。
description.text_en: At its greatest extent, the Black Demesne had eight Acolytes, each of whom wore an ebony ring, numbered from the First to the Eighth in order of magical prowess and prominence within the court. The Sorcerer-King wore a matching ring of dark gold, signifying dominance, which would become known as the Ninth ring. Theoretically, as long as one wore the ring of an Acolyte, one was honorbound to give nothing but absolute loyalty to the legitimate bearer of the Ninth ring in all matters. This reminder of hierarchy and control fortified the political order of the Demesne's upper class.

player_overview.avoid_if: 如果你反感制度化暴行、复杂机制、外交孤立，或不愿为突发的大型终局战争做长期准备，请避开。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 前期以强大法师赢下东坎诺冒险者竞争；中期形成B54，以扩张取得资源并建设亡灵经济；后期用工业、魔法和亡灵军队撑过黑塔之战。
player_overview.overview: 你从法师冒险团铁杖骑士团起步，定居后形成埃斯蒂尔。瓦里娜最初以让死人替活人承担苦役为理想，随后把尸体、灵魂和亡灵军队纳入国家配给体系；中期经营亡灵经济学项目、收割田地和亡者矿坑，后期建造莫古拉克斯，并在黑塔之战中对抗内部叛乱与外部联盟。它是魔法、建设和侵略战争紧密咬合的黑暗长战役。
player_overview.recommended_for: 适合喜欢黑暗国家叙事、魔法项目、资源调配、核心区建设与大规模征服相互促进的玩家。
signature_features: 三级亡灵经济学项目及独立资源界面，让亡者在劳工、士兵、建设与发展之间流动。
瓦里娜、巫妖道路、法师集会所和死亡税构成从学术理想到极权制度的连续故事。
莫古拉克斯飞行要塞与黑塔之战提供高压终局，要求提前准备财政、要塞和战争纵深。
player_overview.tagline: 把死灵术变成国民经济，用不死劳工重建东坎诺，再驾驶飞行黑塔迎战整个大陆。

reasons: 亡灵经济学不是数值包装，而是一套可操作的第二人口经济
国家理想逐步异化为极权暴政，故事转折清晰且有压迫感
莫古拉克斯和黑塔之战让后期拥有真正的总考试
魔法、工业、种田和征服形成强烈的相互反馈
warnings: 黑塔之战会同时施加内乱和外部联盟压力
外交空间小，过早透支财政与人力会被终局惩罚
路线包含制度化屠杀、尸体奴役和灵魂剥削
形成Z99会替换任务树，属于另一条独立战役

positive_indicators: 早期改善活人生活的公共目标
values.rationale: 早期‘让死人劳动、活人繁荣’具有公共利益色彩，但主线逐步制度化杀死兽人与地精作为劳力、死亡税、灵魂利用、肃清和恐怖统治，因此属于明显激进化。
red_flags: 杀死智慧种族转化劳力
